reason: Five of six department notes (HR, IT, Finance, Compliance, Facilities) consistently verify that Dominic Taylor (E004) is a full-time Engineer. Source Code is owned by the Engineer role, so for a full-time employee the maximum access is admin (write, or admin as the role owner).
